referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Array and export cable for onshore wind farm, consisting of 33kV array cable and 110kV export cable. Included processes: manufacturing, transports, installation, replacements, decommission and waste treatement. Calculated for FU of 1km. Data are based on Vestas 100MW onshore wind farm consisting of V163-4.5MW wind turbines (Martinez Aguado & Garrett, 2025).
